scientific_role: replace the former FS-minus-0.10 hard minimum with an evidence-calibrated operational validation goal while retaining FS-minus-0.10 as a stretch tier

scope.model_restriction: none, provided no task-specific pixel, point, scribble, or box supervision is used for training
scope.external_pretraining: permitted only when its provenance is declared and it is not trained on BTXRD validation/test masks
scope.validation_gt: evaluation and protocol-valid selection only after each candidate prediction is frozen

metric_contract.primary_metric: mean per-image Dice over all positive validation images

subgroup_definition.usage: post-prediction validation diagnostic and gate only; never a training or inference input

fully_supervised_reference_sensitivity.interpretation: large has only 18 images and is not stable enough to support a hard threshold only 0.10 below one selected supervised run

literature_evidence.study: Chen and Sun, ACM Computing Surveys 2025
literature_evidence.role: image-level labels are the most challenging WSSS setting; refinement and target-domain adaptation remain central
medical image-level CAM/MIL methods minimize annotation cost but are commonly less accurate than stronger supervision

literature_evidence.transfer_limit: more than one million mammograms, far larger than BTXRD

literature_evidence.study: Yang et al., Medical Image Analysis 2024 AGM
literature_evidence.transfer_limit: OCT and mIoU are not directly interchangeable with BTXRD radiograph per-image Dice

literature_evidence.role: aggregate WSSS metrics can conceal systematic small-object failure
mechanism evidence for a frozen strong encoder, trainable spatial decoder, and dynamic affinity refinement
literature_evidence.transfer_limit: natural images, language supervision, external CLIP pretraining, and mIoU rather than lesion Dice

operational_goal.pass_rule: all four minimum Dice thresholds must be met on the frozen validation cohort under the unchanged complete-miss metric contract

stretch_goal.derivation: frozen fully supervised reference minus 0.10 in every subgroup

decision.reason: million-scale mammography supports approximately 0.10 Dice gaps, but medical OCT retains a 0.1778 mIoU gap, BTXRD small lesions remain a known WSSS failure mode, current internal localization has not produced usable shape, and the large subgroup has only 18 images with 0.14105 supervised-run range
